He describes the Finnish tradition of 'avanto,' involving saunas, ice holes, and near-suicidal experiences.
He mentions the dangers of Midsummer celebrations, advising viewers to urinate in bottles to avoid drowning while intoxicated.
He pokes fun at the Finnish-Swedish and Finnish-Estonian relationships.
